args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding per FIN-212

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN,
per FIN-212), but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build. Import and use
ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, breaking the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py`).
- Changed the import and rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
